interpretation.flat_patterns: Same-code opposite slopes cancel, and absolute levels hide within-patch dynamics. Full waveform has real dynamics; quantization still removes part of it. REFED branch trajectories and extreme Visual drift also fail in the independent continuous model.
interpretation.boundary: Latest Hb waveform target/predicted boundary energy fractions are close; dense_long has severe boundary concentration.
interpretation.state_explanation: Descriptive same-code level/slope distributions available; no candidate qualifies for the planned post-promotion state checks. No physiological advantage over matched ordinary quantization established.
interpretation.next_experiment: Hb: separately test level/slope/residual decoder paths at original objective and K128, retaining independent continuous control. EEG: training-fitted low-dimensional quantization-geometry diagnostic on retained continuous latent before another training campaign.

not_run: no extra subjects, protected/test access, SSM/cache rebuild or masked pretraining
